mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a monetary policy response to persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise and growth risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (INDPRO > 102.0), strong industrial production signals capacity constraints and impending policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion (INDPRO > 102.0), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts trend (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 850,000 units in a 3-month window, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 850,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor force withdrawal and hidden labor market weakness, signaling an impending recession and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a rising core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation requiring further rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) when CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
